description:
Radar Reinvented.

 
 Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM). 

 
 
 Echodyne is seeking a Army Strategic Partner Business Developer (BD) to join our fast-growing team.  

 ROLE OVERVIEW 

 The Army Strategic Partner BD plays a critical role in supporting and enhancing the effectiveness of the sales team focused on federal accounts. This role involves partnering with Army End Customer & Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) to identify opportunities, provide specialized knowledge, and drive strategic sales initiatives for Echodyne radars. The Army Strategic Partner BD will work alongside the sales team to engage with prime/partner/integrator clients, develop tailored solutions, and support the sales process from lead generation to closing deals. They will be responsible for delivering high-impact presentations and demonstrations, addressing complex customer inquiries, and staying up-to-date with industry trends, product developments, and the competitive landscape. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in sales within the federal sector, exceptional interpersonal skills, and a deep understanding of the UAS / CUAS markets.

 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 Function as a Counter-Drone SME, collaborating with Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) and BD personnel to advance Echodyne sales efforts with key Remote Weapon Systems (RWS) players.

 Act as an overlay while aiding BD and RSMs in initiating and advancing sales activities.

 Collaborate effectively with internal teams, including RSMs, Solutions Engineers (SEs), and BD personnel, as well as engage with customers to understand their needs and advance sales efforts.

 Identify internal and external support needed to cultivate strategic partnerships.

 Conduct high-level conversations with senior executives at prospective partners and customers.

 Follow direction from the CRO and sales leaders while collaborating with RSMs, SEs, and BD personnel.

 Work remotely, with travel as necessary.

 Operate on a global scale.

 Perform other related tasks as required to fulfill the needs of the business.

 
 REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE 

 
 Expert understanding of Counter-drone systems, especially in the non-kinetic and airborne interceptor space

 Organized and detail-oriented with excellent follow-up skills

 Demonstrated technical acumen and the ability to articulate technical concepts

 Experienced in owning meetings/presentations at executive levels

 Ability to work in a cross-functional team

 Ability to travel up to 50%

 
 DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE 
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)   

 
 Bachelor of Science degree; preferably in Engineering/Science discipline (with MBA a plus)

 Experience with perimeter security solutions

 Experience working with federal partners/integrators

 Expertise with RF and radar technology

 Experience with UAS solutions and hardware

 
 QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 5 years (minimum) of full-cycle, complex sales

 2 years (minimum) of experience representing technical hardware solutions

 
 
 Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.  

 
 
 WHAT WE OFFER 

 The base salary for this position is $170k - $190k plus commission. 
 If your skills generally align but not perfectly, please apply anyway. There may be another role that’s a great fit for you! 

 We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full-time, US-based employees, including: 

 
 RSU (Restricted Stock Units)

 Generous Benefits:

 
 Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you 

 
 Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA

 Virtual Care – 98Point6

 Employee Assistance Program

 
 
 Mental Health coverage through Springhealth & Talkspace (Premera)

 Travel Assistance Insurance

 Company Paid Life Insurance

 Company Paid Short & Long Term Disability

 Flexible PTO (exempt) / 15 days per year (non-exempt)

 401(k) match

 Pet Insurance

 Prepaid Legal Program

 Commuter Benefits

 Paid Company Holidays

 
 
  

 All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected by law.
